question: What does the reone project provide for Odyssey engine work?
answer:
reone is an open-source reimplementation effort for the Odyssey engine family, aimed at modern builds, tooling, and research-friendly engine behavior [1]. It complements related projects like xoreos when you need engine-level study rather than only asset or script mods [2].

Sources
[1] https://github.com/seedhartha/reone
[2] https://github.com/xoreos/xoreos
